lines.beaver_en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
lines.learner: 이 층에 있어요. 엘리베이터 옆에 있어요.
lines.en: It's on this floor. It's next to the elevator.
lines.roman: i cheunge isseoyo. ellibeiteo yeope isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. Is the snack shop far?
lines.learner: 아니요, 별로 안 멀어요. 계단 뒤에 있어요.
lines.en: No, it's not very far. It's behind the stairs.
lines.roman: aniyo, byeollo an meoreoyo. gyedan dwie isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 여기가 일 층이에요? 회의실은 위에 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Is this the first floor? Is the meeting room upstairs?
lines.beaver_roman: yeogiga il cheungieyo? hoeuisireun wie isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 여기가 일 층이에요. 회의실은 위에 없어요.
lines.en: Yes, this is the first floor. The meeting room isn't upstairs.
lines.roman: ne, yeogiga il cheungieyo. hoeuisireun wie eopseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then where is the meeting room?
lines.learner: 아래에 있어요. 지하 일 층에 있어요.
lines.en: It's downstairs. It's on basement level one.
lines.roman: araee isseoyo. jiha il cheunge isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do I get to the basement?
lines.learner: 엘리베이터를 타세요. 화장실과 매점 사이에 있어요.
lines.en: Take the elevator. It's between the restroom and the snack shop.
lines.roman: ellibeiteoreul taseyo. hwajangsilgwa maejeom saie isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is there a café near the meeting room too?
lines.en: Yes, there's a café in front of the meeting room.

lines.beaver: 옆 건물에도 가고 싶어요. 밖으로 나가요?
lines.beaver_en: I also want to go to the next building. Do I go outside?
lines.beaver_roman: yeop geonmuredo gago sipeoyo. bakkeuro nagayo?
lines.learner: 아니요, 이 층 가운데에 다리가 있어요.
lines.en: No, there's a bridge in the middle of this floor.
lines.roman: aniyo, i cheung gaundee dariga isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: A bridge? What an interesting place!
lines.learner: 네, 좋은 장소예요. 다리 옆에 정원이 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, it's a nice place. There's a garden next to the bridge.
lines.roman: ne, joeun jangsoyeyo. dari yeope jeongwoni isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 제 차가 밖에 있어요. 주차장은 어디에 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: My car is outside. Where is the parking lot?
lines.beaver_roman: je chaga bakke isseoyo. juchajangeun eodie isseoyo?
lines.learner: 주차장은 건물 밖에 있어요. 정문 옆이에요.
lines.en: The parking lot is outside the building. It's next to the main entrance.
lines.roman: juchajangeun geonmul bakke isseoyo. jeongmun yeopieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you so much for your help.
lines.en: Not at all. Good luck with your meeting!
